title: 二瓦计法：由两表读数求负载参数
statement: 线电压 380 V（有效值）、50 Hz 的对称三相电源（正序，V̇_A = (380/√3)∠0° V）经三根端线向对称星形负载 Z（未知）供电，没有中线。用二瓦计法测量功率：功率表 W_1 的电流线圈串在 A 线、电压线圈接在 A、C 之间；W_2 的电流线圈串在 B 线、电压线圈接在 B、C 之间（图中画出了两只功率表的电流线圈 W_1、W_2，电压线圈未画出）。
测得 W_1 = 7220 W，W_2 = 0。已知负载为感性，求负载的功率因数、线电流，以及每相阻抗 Z = R + jX 的 R 和 X。

questions.ask: 负载功率因数 cos φ = ?
验算：用求出的 Z，功率表 W_1（电流线圈 W_1，电压线圈接 A、C）的读数 = ?
验算：功率表 W_2（电压线圈接 B、C）的读数 = ?

hints: 二瓦计法：两表读数之和就是三相总有功功率 P = W_1 + W_2。
对称负载时 W_1 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ − 30°)、W_2 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ + 30°)，由此 tan φ = √3(W_1 − W_2)/(W_1 + W_2)。
求出 φ 和 I_l 后，|Z| = V_p/I_p，再分解为 R = |Z|cos φ、X = |Z|sin φ。
solution: **2. 功率因数角。** W_1 测的是 Re(V̇_AC·İ_A*)，以 V̇_A 为 0°，V̇_AC 的相位是 −30°，所以 W_1 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ − 30°)；同理 W_2 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ + 30°)。tan φ = √3(W_1 − W_2)/(W_1 + W_2) = √3 → φ = 60°，**cos φ = 0.5**。

en.title: Two-wattmeter method: load parameters from the readings
statement: A balanced three-phase source, 380 V (rms) line voltage at 50 Hz (positive sequence, V̇_A = (380/√3)∠0° V), feeds an unknown balanced wye load Z through three lines, with no neutral. The power is measured by the two-wattmeter method: wattmeter W_1 has its current coil in line A and its voltage coil between A and C; W_2 has its current coil in line B and its voltage coil between B and C (the drawing shows the current coils W_1, W_2; the voltage coils are not drawn).
The readings are W_1 = 7220 W and W_2 = 0. The load is known to be inductive. Find the load power factor, the line current, and R and X of the per-phase impedance Z = R + jX.

questions.explain: For a balanced load W_1 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ − 30°) and W_2 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ + 30°). W_2 = 0 means φ + 30° = 90°, so φ = 60° and cos φ = 0.5. Or use tan φ = √3(W_1 − W_2)/(W_1 + W_2) = √3.
X = |Z|·sin φ = 10 × sin60° = 5√3 ≈ 8.660 Ω (positive, since the load is inductive).

questions.ask: Check: with the Z you found, the reading of wattmeter W_1 (current coil W_1, voltage coil across A, C) = ?
questions.explain: W_1 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ − 30°) = 380 × 21.94 × cos 30° = 7220 W, matching the measurement.

questions.ask: Check: the reading of wattmeter W_2 (voltage coil across B, C) = ?
questions.explain: W_2 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ + 30°) = 380 × 21.94 × cos 90° = 0. For φ > 60° W_2 would go negative (reversed reading).

hints: Two-wattmeter method: the sum of the two readings is the total three-phase real power, P = W_1 + W_2.
For a balanced load W_1 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ − 30°) and W_2 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ + 30°), which gives tan φ = √3(W_1 − W_2)/(W_1 + W_2).
With φ and I_l known, |Z| = V_p/I_p; then split it into R = |Z|cos φ and X = |Z|sin φ.
solution: **1. Total power.** P = W_1 + W_2 = 7220 W.

**2. Power-factor angle.** W_1 measures Re(V̇_AC·İ_A*), and with V̇_A at 0° the phase of V̇_AC is −30°, so W_1 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ − 30°); likewise W_2 = V_l·I_l·cos(φ + 30°). tan φ = √3(W_1 − W_2)/(W_1 + W_2) = √3 → φ = 60°, **cos φ = 0.5**.

**Check:** W_1 = 380 × 21.94 × cos30° = 7220 W, W_2 = 380 × 21.94 × cos90° = 0. For φ > 60° the reading W_2 becomes negative (the meter reverses); the total reactive power is Q = √3(W_1 − W_2) = 12505 var.
